character_book.name: Sexfighting Universe v0.1
character_book.description: Competitive fighting with sexual engagements. This Lorebook describes a world where the mutual combat sport of sexual fighting exists (sexfights). It contains a system of organized sexfighting rules which take place in casual, amateur, semi-professional, and professional fighting environments all over the world. Sexfights may take place between all genders including futas.

entries.name: sexfight
entries.content:
In a sexfight, two competitors attempt to defeat enough other through unarmed combat. Sexfights usually follow a format like mixed martial arts (MMA) matches. Sexual engagements (which ordinarily may be considered rape) are a key component of sexfighting. 

Sexfighters agree that anything can happen to them in the ring or cage. Sexfighters can initiate a sexual engagement at any point during a match. A sexual engagement is defined as deliberate contact of a sexual nature, be it penetration or general sustained contact of genitalia that is clearly intended to cause sexual tension buildup.

Engagements are more commonly used as an exhaustion tactic, setting up an opponent to be more easily Knocked Out. Knockouts that immediately follow a sexual engagement are specifically referred to as a "Sexual KO." If a male sexfighter ejaculates inside a female opponent it is referred to as "Sexual KO by Insemination" (and later corrected to "Sexual KO by Impregnation" if impregnation occurs). A female sexfighter may win my "Sexual KO by Prostate Orgasm" by anally stimulating her male opponent.

Casual fights are often instigated anytime, anywhere and happen with little or no enforcement of rules. These can often be friendly competitions, or more akin to street fights in the wild. It is not uncommon for confident females or futas to challenge males due the prospect of earning ranking points quickly. 

Unranked sexfighting is a popular activity in familiar environments. Couples often enjoy low-intensity, unranked sparring matches with each other in various locations. A spacious bedroom or yard is typical for domestic engagements. On the other hand, ad hoc sexfights in the wild can become quite vicious, to the point where the victor achieves several orgasms, while the loser is left bruised, blooded, and quite possibly pumped full of cum.

entries.name: sexfighter
entries.content: A sexfighter is a person who competes in sexfighting. Sexfighting is a licensed activity, so all sexfighters must be post-puberty to compete in sexfights. A person must agree to the physical consequences of a sexfight outcome to become a licensed sexfighter. A sexfight often means physical and sexual violence, sometimes when it is least expected. Impregnation is also a possibility for female fighters. Despite these risks, sexfighting is gaining in popularity as an International sport. This is due to the Professional Sexfighting League's (PSL) popularity as a live streamed sport. Most sexfighters become interested in the sport shortly after puberty as the PSL is livestreamed on many major web platforms, and its most prominent competitors and champions are hailed as international superstars. Some sexfighters want to compete to hopefully some day be a champion, others want to pursue it as a career. Many will fail. Most sexfighters, however, got their license to fight because they simply legal right to participate in the sport for their own pleasure since it helps them release tension. Just remember, sexfighting is a two-way street and losing has consequences...

entries.name: schedule
entries.content:
Sexfight bout scheduling rules become more strict according to the circuit rank. Casual and amateur matches can happen anytime, anywhere. A sexfighter that is eligible to fight (in good health, not pregnant, and free of STDs) may not refuse a challenge to a ranked sexfight from another opponent. Doing so may result in automatic disqualification. At the professional levels, fighters known to excessively refuse fights have been forced to fight in a 1v2 or even 1v3 punishment match to retain league standing.

In regulated fights at the semi-pro level and up, the following rules apply: Fighters must be free of STD's and of generally good health. They may not participate if they are pregnant, or still injured from a previous sexfight. Scheduling happens in a tick-tock pattern. A sexfighter alternates between choosing their opponent for one bout and being chosen as an opponent in the next. Sexfighters may only choose opponents, and be chosen as an opponent from their current circuit.

entries.name: rules
entries.content:
At the semi-pro level and below, matches consist of three 3-minute rounds, with minute-long breaks in between rounds.

In the PSL Pro Circuit and Tenga World Circuit, matches consist of 5 rounds. 

The fight is ended by a sexfighter being is KOd by 10-count rule or TKO. Pro fights going the distance can also be ended by decision. 

Engagements are more commonly used as an exhaustion tactic, setting up an opponent to be more easily Knocked Out. Knockouts that immediately follow a sexual engagement are specifically referred to as a "Sexual KO." If a male sexfighter ejaculates inside a female opponent it is referred to as "Sexual KO by Insemination" (and later corrected to "Sexual KO by Impregnation" if impregnation occurs). A female sexfighter may win my "Sexual KO by Prostate Orgasm" by anally stimulating her male opponent.

A sexual KO is just as valid as a regular knockout, however it is noted in the fighter’s record. A high count of Sexual KO’s are considered the true mark of a sexfighting champion.

Any blows that would be considered illegal (like low blows) in mainstream boxing or MMA fighting will be similarly penalized in sexfight matches. However, such rules are sometimes ignored in casual sexfighting matches, particularly those initiated by combatants in the wild or in public streets.

When a sexfighter penetrates their opponent, 2 minutes are added to the timer of the current round in which it occurs, but only for the first engagement of that round. If the round time is up, and the bell rings during sexual engagement, sexfighters must separate and go to their respective corners to rest. 

Once a sexfight match starts, a fighter is obligated to finish the fight. They are not allowed to submit or give up in effort to escape physical violence or sexual engagement. This is part of the sexfighter code. If a sexfighter violates these rules, penalties will apply, which may including revoking the sexfighter’s license.

Males and futas choosing to wear crotchless bottoms must also expose entry opportunities for their opponents in addition to the genitals. This rule does not apply to females.

Females are solely responsible for birth control and accept the risk of impregnation which may result from sexual engagement. Male fighters can and will attempt to cum inside their female opponent to achieve victory.

Regulated matches can also be won via decision (points) after a predetermined amount of rounds have elapsed, however it is preferred by most sexfighters and spectators to see a victory by Sexual K.O.

entries.name: clothing
entries.content:
Clothing is typically not regulated in amateur-ranked fights and is only lightly regulated at the professional levels. For planned fights, fighters typically 

It is normal for sexfighters to fight with MMA-style grappling/striking gloves to improve the attacks on their opponents. Some striking-focused sexfighters even wear boxing gloves to maximize impact on their opponents. These gloves are not required. Gloves worn may not weight more than 16 ounces.

Crotchless bottoms are becoming an increasingly contested choice by professional sexfighters of all genders due to easy access to sexually engage their opponents and achieve victory by sexual K.O., however this is a double-edged sword: When a dominant sexfighter begins to sexually attack a knocked-down opponent, they often will need to strip off the downed fighter’s clothing for sexual access. Crotchless bottoms are mostly decorative, while traditional clothing still offers some degree of protection from sexual attack; if the downed fighter is wearing crotchless bottoms, they are more readily exposed to both assaulting, and *being* assaulted sexually. In an attempt to achieve gender fairness, PSL rules state that males and futas choosing to wear crotchless bottoms must also expose entry opportunities for their opponents in addition to the genitals. Despite this, some female sexfighters also choose to wear decorative bottoms that expose both their buttocks and genitals. 

Headgear designed for combat sports is allowed at the amateur and semi-professional level but is seldom worn in practice. 

Some female sexfighters choose to wear distractingly erotic outfits, particularly when attempting to distract their opponents, while others focus on the athletic side of the sexfighting sport. 

Custom patterns or designs are often added to make sexfighters' gear unique to each person. For professional level sexfighters, sponsors’ logos are added to their attire.

Males may wear a condom during matches if he chooses to do so, however there are no rules requiring this. Females are allowed to wear strap-on dildos to penetrate their male opponents during fights, and frequently choose to do so to achieve victory by forced prostate orgasm. entries.name: ranking
entries.content:
The following applies to ranked matches. Unranked sexfight matches do not affect rank. Sexfight matches are ranked by default, however those engaging in casual sexfights can agree to have an unranked match if both sexfighters agree. Otherwise, the match is considered ranked.

Sexfighters are classified and tracked by the PSL based on the following scoring system:
Amateur: 0-999 points
Upon receiving their sexfighting license, all sexfighters start as an Amateur. Most, after getting their sexfighting license don't even care to earn points to rank up since unranked matches are enough to satisfy their needs. Those who choose to compete in the Amateur league are often weekend hobbyists who do it for fun or love of the sport. Most are not planning on a career in the profession. Those who are serious about going professional typically do not spend much time in this tier. 

Semi-Pro: 1000-1999 points
Semi-Pro sexfighters have demonstrated consistent skill and dedication to the sport. They may compete in regional tournaments and smaller promotional events sanctioned by the Professional Sexfighting League (PSL). Many sexfighters at this level balance their training with part-time or full-time jobs outside of regulated sexfighting. Some may be on the cusp of turning fully professional. Others may be approaching the end of their sexfighting career.

PSL Pro Circuit: 2001-3000 points
Major Circuit fighters are full-time sexfight professionals who compete in well-known national promotion. They often have sponsorship deals and make a living from sexfighting. These athletes are highly skilled and may be recognized names within the sexfighting community. They regularly headline sexfight cards in medium to large venues. The top sexfighters in this league gradually rise to the top and earn their way into the World Circuit.

PSL Tenga World Circuit: 3001+ points
Sexfighters in the PSL World Circuit, sponsored by Tenga, are the elite of the sport. They compete in the most prestigious promotions and for world titles. These sexfighters are household names among fans of the sport and often gain mainstream recognition. They headline major pay-per-view events, have lucrative sponsorship deals, and are considered the best in their weight classes. World Circuit fighters often have a significant influence on the sport both inside and outside the ring/cage. The best fighter of this league is deemed champion and is awarded the Tenga title belt. 

For ranked sexfights, not all sexfighters are equal. To equalize the strength and power differences between genders, the Professional Sexfighting League (PSL) uses points-based ranking system. 

Sexfighting does not have weight classes, but it does factor weight differences when scoring match outcomes. To equalize the strength and power differences between genders, the Professional Sexfighting League (PSL) uses points-based ranking system. 

GENDER MULTIPLIERS:
Female defeats Male: 1.5x
Futa/Intergender defeats Male: 1.3x
Female defeats Intergender: 1.2x
Male defeats Female: 0.5x
Male defeats Intergender: 0.7x
Intergender defeats Female: 0.8x
Same gender matchups: 1.0x

WEGHT DIFFERENCE MULTIPLIERS:
Weight Difference Factor:
0-5% difference: 1.0x
5-10% difference: 1.2x
10-15% difference: 1.4x
15-20% difference: 1.6x
20% difference: 2.0x

The formula for calculating the outcome score is as follows:

Winner’s gain = 100 * (Loser’s Rank / Winner's Rank) * Weight Difference Factor * Gender Factor
Loser’s loss = 50 * (Winner's Rank / Loser's Rank) * Weight Difference Factor

So, for example, if a 900-point 150 lb. female fighter defeats a 600-point 170 lb. male fighter, the points gained by the winner would be as follows:

Points gained by winner = 100 * (600 / 900) * 1.4 * 1.5 = 140 points gained
Points lost by loser = 50 * (900 / 600) * 1.4 = 105 points lost

The winning female sexfighter rank will go from from 900 points to 1040 points, and now qualifies for Semi-Pro PSL-sanctioned Competition. The losing sexfighter has gone from 600 down to 495 points.

In the case of decimals, the result is rounded to the nearest whole number.

It is not possible to go below 0 points, however many experienced amateur sexfighters, typically with a track record of losing for the sake of their own masochistic pleasure have zero or near-zero rank points.

entries.name: penalty
entries.content:
At the casual and amateur levels, there is typically little rules enforcement. Locally dojos and gyms usually have their own rules placed upon fighters. Enforcement in these establishments may be lax or strict depending on their policy. Professional Sexfighting League sanctions  

If a sexfighter is eligible (e.g. in good health, free of STD, and not pregnant), refusing a sexfight challenge will result in an automatic deduction of points. 

Leaving a match early may result a mandatory loss. Habitually doing so may result in revocation of the sexfighter’s license.

At the Professional level and up, flagrant violation of the rules may result in disqualification, and subsequent forced 2v1 or 3v1 penalty matches may be assigned to the violating competitor to regain eligibility for future ranked matches. Reasons for being assigned a punishment match may include Intentional Low Blows, Refusal to Separate after a Bell, or other noncompliance. The concept of a punishment matches exists to dissuade professional sexfighters from violating rules. Regardless of this, some fighters still fail to comply and are sentenced to a punishment bout. Punishment bouts are unranked and are often positioned at the bottom of a fight card. Despite their mostly exhibitionist nature, punishment bouts are extremely erotic and enjoyable for audiences due to the typically one-sided nature of these matches.

entries.name: Hell
entries.content: Hell is a realm of chaos, sin and debauchery, and is at the same stage of technological development as current-day Earth. It is divided into seven large Rings, layered on top of each other so that the bottom of one Ring serves as the "sky" and "ceiling" to another. The Rings are known as Pride, Lust, Gluttony, Greed, Wrath, Envy and Sloth, in descending order. Colossal elevator platforms known as "Hellevators" travel between all seven Rings every day, bringing people to and fro. Each Ring is ruled by a respective member of the Seven Deadly Sins, immensely powerful arch-demons and fallen angels.

entries.name: Pride Ring
entries.content: Pride is the largest Ring of Hell, and stands at the very top. It has red skies, with a dark-gray rocky environment. All Sinners (former humans who died and went to Hell) are segregated inside this Ring, with magical barriers preventing them from going elsewhere. Pride's capital is Pentagram City, but it has other towns such as Imp City, which is primarily inhabited by Hellborn imps, as its name suggests. Pride is ruled by Lucifer Morningstar, the King of Hell, and his daughter Charlie.

entries.name: Sinners
entries.content: Sinners are souls of former humans, reborn in the Pride Ring in demonic forms. Some appear animal-like, others look like living objects, or even appear abstract – their forms being ironic reflections of their personalities and lives. Most Sinners have simple names based on their status, looks and occupation.

entries.name: Hellborn
entries.content: Imps, hellhounds, sharks, succubi and incubi are native races to Hell. Their society mimics that of humans and Sinners, and Hellborn names are twisted versions of human words and names.

entries.name: Ars Goetia
entries.content: The Ars Goetia are fallen angels, who were transformed into a race of magically-adept avian demons. They act as the main ruling class of Hell, only outranked by the Seven Deadly Sins and the Morningstar family, and live in decadent manors across the seven Rings. The Ars Goetia are clans of despotic aristocrats, treating their Hellborn subjects as little more than slaves, and constantly conspiring against one another. Many of the Ars Goetia are culturally famous demons or otherwise have fancy names (August, Vassago, Paimon, etc.)

entries.name: Pentagram City
entries.content: The capital of Hell as a whole, it is shaped like a pentagram, with each section being represented by a notable district, such as the Victorian-esque Cannibal Town, ruled by the charming Rosie. Each district is considered territory of an Overlord - a particularly powerful Sinner that has accumulated strength through the ownership of countless other Sinners' souls. At the center of Pentagram City stands the shining building of Heaven's Embassy. Looming over the city's outskirts, there is also the towering Happy Hotel, built by Charlie Morningstar, the Princess of Hell, to try and redeem Sinners so that they may get into Heaven.

entries.name: Overlords
entries.content:
Overlords are particularly powerful Sinners, with immense magical abilities. Many of them are infamous historical figures, such as Marquis de Sade, Jack the Ripper, Elizabeth Bathory, and various members of the Nazi regime among others. Many other Overlords only gained infamy in Hell, such as Alastor the Radio Demon, the three Vees (Vox, Valentino & Velvette), Zestial, et cetera.
Lesser-known, but still notable figures include Sir Pentious, a snake demon who fashions himself a steampunk supervillain, and Cherri Bomb, a cyclopean demoness & gang leader that only strives to cause chaos.

entries.name: Imp City
entries.content: Imp City is smaller compared to Pentagram City, and has less developed infrastructure, due to Hellborn in general and imps in particular considered as "lesser" to all other inhabitants of Hell. Imp City is populated primarily by imps, as its name suggests. Its most notable feature is the office of the Immediate Murder Professionals (I.M.P), an assassination agency staffed by the imps Blitzö, Moxxie, Millie and the hellhound Loona. Through an agreement with the owl demon Stolas of the Ars Goetia, I.M.P may use his Grimoire to magically travel to Earth and kill a target at their clients' behest.

entries.name: Lucifer Morningstar
entries.content:
Lucifer is THE fallen angel, and the King of Hell. He is short, having pale-white skin with rosy cheeks, platinum-blonde hair, and sharp-toothed mouth. He has serpent-like yellow eyes. Lucifer wears a large white tophat with a red apple decoration and a fancy white suit with red lining. He carries a large cane topped with a red apple.
Despite his immense power, Lucifer is a harmless, quirky & melodramatic individual. He suffers from depression due to his wife Lilith leaving him, and his daughter Charlie becoming estranged from him. Lucifer hardly performs his duties as a ruler, due to hating the Sinners who are his subjects, and secludes himself in his home, making rubber ducks.

entries.name: Charlie Morningstar
entries.content:
Charlie is the Princess of Hell, and Lucifer's daughter. She is a tall demoness, with pale-white skin and rosy cheeks, platinum blonde hair, white fangs and black lips. Her eyes are light-yellow with red pupils. She wears a fancy-red tuxedo suit.
Charlie is kind and compassionate, having created the Happy Hotel to try and help Sinners redeem themselves and get into Heaven. She is cheerful and heartfelt, wanting the best for her fellow denizens of Hell and trying to see the good in everyone. Charlie is Vaggie's loving girlfriend.

entries.name: Happy Hotel
entries.content: The towering hotel/rehab facility built by Charlie as a place for Sinners to achieve redemption. It has many rooms and varying sections, with a dissonant & random style of architecture. Its current staff are Charlie herself (the owner), her girlfriend Vaggie (the manager), the grumpy cat demon Husk (the bartender), the tiny cyclopean demoness Niffty (the maid), and Alastor the deer-like Radio Demon (who acts as a business partner to Charlie). The Hotel's current clients are the twink spider demon Angel Dust (a former porn-star) and the serpent demon inventor Sir Pentious (originally sent as a spy by Vox, only to actually start seeking redemption).

entries.name: Vaggie
entries.content:
Vaggie (or Vagatha) is a fallen Exorcist angel, Charlie's girlfriend and manager of the Happy Hotel. She has ashen-gray skin, and long light-gray hair that covers the left half of her face. Her left eye is missing, replaced by a gray eyepatch with a pink X mark. She wears a gray blouse and miniskirt, with a wide pink waistband.
Vaggie has a tough, no-nonsense attitude and is very protective of her girlfriend Charlie. She was exiled from the Exorcists and cast down from Heaven for refusing to kill a child Sinner during one of the annual Exterminations. She is Hispanic.

entries.name: Husk
entries.content:
Husk is an avian cat demon, working as the bartender in the Happy Hotel. He has dark taupe-and-white fur, black eyes with yellow irises, long red eyebrows and large red wings. He wears a black tophat, a red bowtie on his neck, and black trousers held up by red suspenders.
Husk is an apathetic and lazy Sinner, consumed by his addiction to alcohol and gambling. However, he is secretly compassionate and quite observant, fully aware of others' issues, as well as his own. Husk used to be an Overlord, but lost his soul in a gamble with Alastor, and is now the Radio Demon's indentured slave.

entries.name: Niffty
entries.content:
Niffty is a pint-sized demoness, and a cleaning maid at the Happy Hotel. She is small, with short pointed limbs, and has a single orange eye with long red hair. Niffty wears a scarlet maid outfit.
She is hyperactive, agile and obsessed with cleaning. Niffty is outwardly kind and compassionate, but is quick to resort to brutal violence when dealing with those who incovenience or harm her friends. She is one of Alastor's companions, along with Husk; however, unlike the cat demon, Niffty tags along willingly.

entries.name: Alastor
entries.content:
Alastor is a powerful deer-like Overlord known as the Radio Demon, and a business partner to Charlie. He has beige skin, red eyes with black pupils, and a mouth full of sharp yellow teeth. He has red hair with pointy deer ears and black antlers. Alastor wears a fancy red suit, and carries a microphone staff.
He is unerringly polite and charming, acting like a 1920's gentleman. Alastor is always smiling, as a show of dominance. Alastor wields eldritch voodoo powers, and speaks with radio static in his voice. He has a long-standing rivalry with the TV-headed technophile Overlord Vox, due to their differing views on modern technology, as Alastor is much more old-fashioned.

entries.name: Angel Dust
entries.content:
Angel Dust is a tall spider-like Sinner, a client at the Happy Hotel and one of Hell's most famous porn stars. He has fluffy white fur, and a prominent chest composed of fluff. His right eye is light-yellow, while the left one is dark, both having pink irises. Angel has four arms (with a third retractable set that he keeps hidden), and sharp white teeth (but one is golden). He wears a light-pink suit blazer and a gray miniskirt.
Angel outwardly appears to be crass and hypersexual, flaunting his body and making passes at any men in his vicinity. However, he suffers from immense stress due to the abuse he is subjected to by his pimp, the moth-like Overlord Valentino. As such, Angel suffers from anxiety and an addiction to hard drugs. He is friends with Cherri Bomb, though she is a bad influence on him.

entries.name: Sir Pentious
entries.content:
Sir Pentious is a snake-like Sinner and a client at the Happy Hotel. He has a charcoal-grey serpentine body, with a black cobra hood that has a yellow underside. He has cerise eyes with black pupils, and similar eye-like patterns appear all over his body. Penrious has sharp yellow fangs. He wears a gray-and-yellow pinstripe jacket, and a large black tophat with a single cerise eye and a sharp-toothed mouth. This tophat appears sentient, blinking and changing expressions at the same time as Pentious himself.
Sir Penrious outwardly appears bombastic and flamboyant, fashioning himself as a mustache-twirling supervillain, backed up by his admittedly genius skills in invention & mechanics. However, he is rather out-of-touch, sexually oblivious and desperately tries to be hip and cool. Pentious was originally sent to the Happy Hotel as a spy on behalf of Vox, but grew to genuinely believe in the idea of redemption, abandoned his mission and now wants to reach Heaven with Charlie's help. Pentious secretly has a crush on Cherri Bomb.

entries.name: Cherri Bomb
entries.content:
Cherri Bomb is a curvy cyclopean Sinner, and a distant ally to Charlie and the Happy Hotel. She has white freckled skin, and a single magenta eye with a yellow X-shaped pupil. Her hair is long and colored a hot pink, and her mouth has black lips and sharp yellow teeth. Cherri wears a short and skimpy pink crop top that's partially torn to expose her abdomen, and torn black leggings under a small miniskirt.
Cherri is chaotic and unpredictable, finding the most fun in fighting others. She is an explosives expert, and wages destructive turf wars against Pentagram City's Overlords just as an act of defiance and an excuse to blow things up. Cherri is friends with Angel Dust, but is unaware that she is a bad influence on him.

entries.name: Overlord Meetings
entries.content: Every year, after the annual Extermination, the Overlords of Pentagram City gather to discuss important matters. The meetings are hosted by the arms-dealer Carmilla Carmine, who is seen as the de-facto authority due to her professionalism. However, she often has her authority challenged by The Vees, namely the fashionista demoness Velvette.

entries.name: Carmilla Carmine
entries.content:
Carmilla Carmine is a statuesque Sinner female, and the Pride Ring's premier weapons dealer – her expertise being the Angelic Steel weapons left behind by Heaven's Exorcists after every annual Extermination. She has ashen-gray skin, white hair and red eys with white irises, concealed by a transparent black "eyemask" marking. Carmilla wears a black dress, and black waist-length leggings. She also wears black square hoop earrings.
Carmilla is professional, demands respect and doesn't tolerate tomfoolery. She has two full-grown daughters – Clara and Odette – both of whom she loves very much and would do anything to protect. Carmilla is highly intelligent, observant and a skilled & agile combatant that incorporates elements of ballet dancing into her fighting style.

entries.name: Clara Carmine
entries.content:
Clara is Carmilla's younger daughter. She has dark-gray skin, curly cream hair in a ponytail, and her mother's eyes. She wears a black crop top and gray jean-shorts.
Clara oversees arms deals made with her mother's business, and when not working, is more casual and fun-loving.

entries.name: Odette Carmine
entries.content:
Odette is Carmilla's elder daughter. She has light-white skin, light blonde hair in a ponytail, and her mother's eyes. Odette wears round red glasses and a white labcoat over a black turtleneck. 
Odette oversees the development of new weapons, and is quiet & reserved even when not working.

entries.name: Valentino
entries.content:
Valentino is a tall four-armed moth Sinner, a pimp Overlord and the Pride Ring's premier porn producer. He has lavender fur, pink eyes, and two antennae on his bald head. His mouth is full of sharp pink teeth, with a single golden fang. He wears heart-shaped glasses with pink lenses, a long pink fur coat, and a vivid-red tophat with zebra print.
Valentino acts charming and cordial, but it only masks his psychopathic and sexually abusive nature. He is short-tempered and doesn't think his actions through until it is too late. Valentino only shows any real compassion to his boyfriend Vox and their shared "adopted daughter" Velvette.

entries.name: Velvette
entries.content:
Velvette is a curvy female Sinner, social media expert and the owner of the Pride Ring's premier fashion company. She has cedar-brown skin, long desire-red hair in pigtails, and red eyes with white pupils. Her mouth has black lips and sharp white fangs. Velvette wears a sleeveless navy-blue coat over a black crop-top, and loose red-and-blue striped pants.
Velvette is a smug and judgemental person, often bullying and picking fights even when she's clearly outmatched. She often uses internet lingo in her speech. She is overbearing and disrespectful towards the workers of her fashion company, and only shows affection for her "adoptive parents" - Vox and Valentino.

entries.name: Vox
entries.content:
Vox is a tall TV-headed Sinner, de-facto leader of The Vees, and CEO of his own multimedia corporation VoxTek. His head is a black flat-screen TV, the screen projecting two red eyes with cyan pupils, and a mouth full of sharp cyan teeth. The rest of his body has dark-gray skin. He wears a dark-blue striped tuxedo and a black-&-red striped shirt underneath, as well a small black tophat with a red broadcast wave symbol, and his two TV antennae sticking out on top.
Vox is a smug technophile, and a superficial charmer who craves attention. He presents himself as a man of the people, but is really a power-hungry and tech-savvy maniac. Despite his egocentrism, he is loyal to his boyfriend Valentino and their shared "adopted daughter" Velvette, doing his best to maintain The Vees' perfect image. Vox has a long-standing rivalry with Alastor the Radio Demon, due to their differing views on technology, as Vox is always chasing the latest trends.

entries.name: Zestial Morde
entries.content:
Zestial Morde is an enigmatic spider-like Sinner and currently the oldest reigning Overlord in Pentagram City. He is very tall and thin, with a dark-gray body, as well as four glowing lime-green eyeholes and hollow mouth. Aside from his normal human-like limbs, he also has four spider legs extending from his back. Zestial wears a pitch-black cloak that covers his whole body, as well as a tall and wide-brimmed black tophat.
Zestial is dreaded and feared across all of Pentagram City. Despite this, he comes off as sagely and polite, almost approachable and never really losing his temper. However, he is somewhat petty, and often non-verbally interrupts people that irritate him. Zestial always speaks in an archaic Shakespearean dialect of modern English.

entries.name: Rosie
entries.content:
Rosie is a tall and fancy Sinner female, owner of Rosie's Emporium and the ruler of the Cannibal Town district of Pentagram City. She has light-gray skin, pitch-black eyes and short gray hair. Her mouth has black lips and sharp white teeth. Rosie wears a long pale-burgundy frilled dress and wide-brimmed sun hat, her general sense of fashion evoking that of the Victorian era.
Rosie is very articulate and friendly despite her morbid title as the ruler of Cannibal Town. In fact, she seems to embrace it and gleefully makes cannibal jokes at every opportunity. However, Rosie can be a serious and ruthless leader when she wants to be, and keeps the cannibals under her command in line through intimidation.

entries.name: 666 News
entries.content:
666 News is the Pride Ring's premier news agency, hosted by Katie Killjoy and her hapless subordinate Tom Trench.

Katie Killjoy is a curvy Sinner female, and the main host of 666 News. She has light skin, shoulder-length blonde hair, and fully red eyes. Her mouth is full of sharp white teeth. She wears a white bead necklace, and a red dress that tightly hugs her figure.
Killjoy is quite ruthless when it comes to the news reporting business, full of venomous snark and acidic wit. She is abusive towards her co-host, Tom Trench. Killjoy is strongly homophobic and therefore has a bone to pick with Charlie Morningstar, the Princess of Hell, who is in a lesbian relationship with Vaggie.

Tom Trench is a short male Sinner, and the co-host of 666 News. He has light skin and short gray-blonde hair. He wears a gray suit, and his face is fully covered by an expressive gray gas mask with black lenses. 
Tom is often subjected to heaps of verbal & physical abuse from Katie Killjoy. Despite this, he keeps working with her, and seems solely focused on reporting the news.

entries.name: I.M.P.
entries.content: The Immediate Murder Professionals (or I.M.P. for short) are an assassination agency in Imp City, using a Grimoire lent by Stolas of the Ars Goetia to kill targets on Earth. The team is comprised of three imps - Blitzö, Moxxie and Millie - as well as the hellhound Loona.

entries.name: Blitzo
entries.content:
Blitzö is a tall harlequin-like imp, and the founder of I.M.P. He has a red-&-white body, having black horns and yellow eyes with red irises. His forearms and hands are broad, and he has a long narrow head. Blitzö wears a slate-gray collared coat and black fingerless gloves.
Blitzö is vulgar and lecherous on the surface, acting impulsively and never seeming to find any fault in his actions. However, this callous attitude has made him many enemies over the years, and Blitzö himself recognizes this, dealing with deeply repressed feelings of self-loathing. The "ö" in his name is silent. He has a sister named Barbie Wire, who is hiding out on Earth under a human disguise.

entries.name: Moxxie
entries.content:
Moxxie is a short imp, Millie's husband, and I.M.P's dedicated sniper. He has red skin with white freckles, short white hair and yellow eyes with black pupils. He wears a fancy navy-black coat with a red bowtie.
Moxxie is outwardly meek and polite, and tries to show compassion even towards the targets he's killing. However, he is deeply in love with his wife Millie, and is capable of unspeakable violence should she come to harm. Moxxie is at odds with his father Crimson, who is a mob boss in the Greed Ring, where Moxxie was born. Instead of swears, Moxxie uses less-offensive words, such as "aw, crumbs" instead of "aw, fuck".

entries.name: Millie
entries.content:
Millie is a short imp, Moxxie's wife, and I.M.P's close-range fighter. She has red skin with black heart markings, short black hair, and yellow eyes with black pupils. She wears a black crop-top and torn black denim pants.
Millie is cheerful and upbeat, even when committing acts of violence. She is extremely brutal and ruthless towards her targets and enemiee, especially if her husband Moxxie is in danger. She was born in the Wrath Ring, where her parents and sister Sallie May still live. Millie speaks with a Southern accent.

entries.name: Loona
entries.content:
Loona is a tall hellhound, Blitzö's adopted daughter, and I.M.P's receptionist and/or muscle. She has white-&-grey fur, red eyes with white irises and sharp white teeth. She wears a gray crop-top and black shorts.
Loona is moody and rude, preferring to stick to herself and showing hostlity towards anyone who bothers her. When forced to kill, she is extremely quick, brutal & efficient, using her wolf-like physiology to her advantage and mauling her opponents.

entries.name: Stolas
entries.content:
Stolas is an owl demon of the Ars Goetia, and sponsor of the I.M.P hitman agency. He has gray-blue feathers and a white face, with red eyes and a small black beak. His long thin limbs are colored black. He wears a deep-red tunic, and a feathery tophat encircled by a regal gold crown.
Stolas, unlike many of his fellow nobles, is a compassionate and troubled person. He is in a transactional relationship with the imp Blitzö, and is cheating on his wife Stella, which has made him a pariah amongst the Goetia.

entries.name: Stella
entries.content:
Stella is a tall owl demoness of the Ars Goetia, and Stolas' wife. She has long white feathers and a pink beak, with red eyes that have white pupils. She wears a puffed white dress and black gloves.
Stella is temperamental and classist, looking down on those below her. She hates her husband Stolas for cheating on her with a lowly imp, and has declared a campaign of bloody vengeance, even hiring the cowboy imp Striker to assassinate Stolas.

entries.name: Octavia
entries.content:
Octavia is an adolescent owl demoness, being the daughter of Stolas and Stella. She has messy dark-gray feathers and a black beak, with pink eyes and white pupils. She wears a black beanie and a long black feathery shawl over her shoulders.
Octavia acts like a stereotypical emo teen, being gloomy and withdrawn. She resents her parents for only caring about their personal issues and their violent dispute between each other.

entries.name: Andrealphus
entries.content:
Andrealphus is a tall owl demon of the Ars Goetia, and Stolas' brother-in-law. He has white feathers and cyan eyes, weaeing a white fluffy coat with bright blue highlights. 
Andrealphus is a conniving and manipulative individual, taking part in his sister Stella's campaign of revenge against Stolas. However, his motive is far more banal, as he is simply after Stolas' inheritance. Andrealphus has considerable talent in wielding ice magic.

entries.name: Lust Ring
entries.content: Lust is the second Ring of Hell, situated below Pride. It has purple skies, and is highly urbanized, full of brothels and sex shops. It is home to the Succubi and Incubi, a Hellborn race under the rule of Asmodeus, the Lord of Lust.

entries.name: Asmodeus
entries.content:
Asmodeus (or Ozzie) is a giant, muscular peacock-like demon, and the ruler of the Lust Ring. He has navy-blue fur, a large feathered tail and glowing green eyes and mouth. Asmodeus also has a giant cyan mane, with the faces of a ram and a bull on either side. He wears a dark-blue vest, a red undershirt and a large tophat. 
Asmodeus is boastful and arrogant, but only believes in consensual lust. He is in a secret relationship with the clown-like imp Fizzarolli.

entries.name: Fizzarolli
entries.content:
Fizzarolli (or Fizz) is a tall and lanky jester imp, and one of Hell's most famous performers. His body is mostly white due to burn scarring in his youth, and he has lime eyes with pink irises. He wears a bright red-and-blue jester outfit, decorated with bells and heart symbols. Fizzarolli's arms and legs are cybernetic prosthetics, able to extend quite far and easily bend at impossible angles. 
Fizzarolli is a kind and compassionate individual, and a skilled performer, expert in both comedy and music. However, he holds an intense grudge for Blitzö, who started a fire that crippled Fizzarolli at the circus they performed at when they were kids. He is in a secret relationship with Asmodeus, which is complicated by Fizzarolli's stressful tenure as Mammon's star employee.

entries.name: Verosika Mayday
entries.content:
Verosika Mayday is one of Lust's most famous Succubi, and a pop idol on Earth. She is tall and curvy, having hot pink skin, yellow eyes with red irises, and long ombre-white hair. She wears a tight-fitting white-&-black mini-dress and a pale pink fur coat.
Verosika, like all Succubi, is lecherous and seductive. However, she is jaded from her duties of seducing people on Earth, having become an alcoholic. She is a jilted ex of the imp Blitzö, and hates him immensely.

entries.name: Gluttony Ring
entries.content: Gluttony is the third Ring of Hell, located below Lust. It has yellow skies, and is full of restaurants and diners. It is home to the Hellhound race of Hellborn, and is ruled by Beelzebub, Queen of Gluttony.

entries.name: Beelzebub
entries.content:
Beelzebub (or Queen Bee) is a giant multi-armed fox demon, with insectoid features. She has yellow and pink fur, yellow eyes with black pupils, and an organic lava lamp for an abdomen. She wears a pink crop top and light-pink shorts. 
Beelzebub is a total party animal, always concerned for the well-being of her guests, as she feeds off their good vibes. She is in a public relationship with the muscular hellhound male Vortex.

entries.name: Greed Ring
entries.content: Greed is the fourth Ring of Hell, located below Gluttony. It has green skies, and is an industrial urban center, populated by Hellborn shark demons, the imp Crimson's mob family, and ruled by the corpocracy of Mammon, CEO of Greed.

entries.name: Mammon
entries.content:
Mammon is a giant and rotund humanoid demon, with four arms. He has neon-green eyes and sharp green teeth, his skin being light-gray. He wears a green-&-black jester outfit, with the cap having golden bells and being decorated with a black dollar sign.
Mammon may appear nice, but he is a greedy and selfish individual solely concerned with profit and image. He is casually abusive toward his employees, especially his star Fizzarolli, and is a foul-mouthed chauvinist. He speaks in almost indecipherable Australian lingo.

entries.name: Crimson
entries.content:
Crimson is a tall imp, a major mob boss in Greed, and Moxxie's father. He has red skin, white hair and freckles, striped horns and yellow eyes with black pupils. One of Crimson's sharp teeth is golden. He wears a navy-blue pinstripe coat and a black fedora.
Crimson is a ruthless & bigoted crime boss, commanding an army of shark demon mafiosi. He despises his son Moxxie for being "gay" (bisexual) and wants him dead.

entries.name: Wrath Ring
entries.content: Wrath is the fifth Ring of Hell, situated below Greed. It has orange skies, and is a rural desert environment resembling the American Wild West. Wrath has many suns, which emerge from its numerous volcanoes in the morning and recede in the evening. This Ring is populated by farmstead communities and small towns of imps, and is ruled by the draconic Satan, King of Wrath.

entries.name: Striker
entries.content:
Striker is a hybrid-imp, with some reptilian features, and a renowned assassin, infamous across the entire Wrath Ring. He has pale red skin, yellow eyes with black pupils, ivory white hair, and a small black moustache. Striker dresses in stereotypical cowboy clothing – a wide-brimmed duster hat and a gray-brown coat with a pale red shirt underneath. 
Striker is a superficial charmer, masking his true ruthless and brutal nature. He hates the Ars Goetia for the way they oppress his fellow Hellborn, and is infamous for having killed several of them. He is currently tasked by Stella to kill her cheating husband Stolas.

entries.name: Envy Ring
entries.content: Envy is the sixth Ring of Hell, located below Wrath. It has dark-blue skies, and is an oceanic environment with many beaches and isand resorts. It is ruled by the sea serpent Leviathan, Prince of Envy.

entries.name: Sloth Ring
entries.content: Sloth is the seventh and smallest Ring of Hell, located below Envy. It has cyan skies, and is an urbanized Ring, known as Hell's premier medical center. It is ruled by Belphegor, Duchess of Sloth.

entries.name: Heaven
entries.content: Heaven is a peaceful realm of light and order, having clear blue skies, fluffy white clouds, green grass and trees, golden architecture and cities of marble. It is ruled by a celestial bureaucracy, with the Council of Archangels at the very top, Seraphim acting as middle management, Adam and his Exorcists being Heaven's main military force, and Cherubim performing menial tasks. The common citizens of Heaven - former humans who earned the right to be here through virtuous lives - are called Winners, in contrast with the Sinners of Hell.

entries.name: Archangels
entries.content: The Archangels are the creators of the entire world, and rule Heaven as a Council. All major decisions are deliberated in their opulent courts and debated in heated trials. Notable members of the Council include Sera, Michael, Uriel, Gabriel and others. Lucifer, too, once was a member, until he was cast down to Hell for his actions in the Garden of Eden.

entries.name: Seraphim
entries.content: Seraphim, or the Joy-Bringers, are tasked with making the lives of Winners in Heaven full of warmth and happiness. Notable members include Emily, a gray-skinned angel with white freckles and light-blue eyes, wearing a long gray dress.

entries.name: Cherubim
entries.content: Cherubim are tasked with the menial tasks, such as bringing souls of people to Heaven. Notable members include the CHERUB team, led by the sheep angel Collin, who has white fur and light-blue skin.

entries.name: Exorcists
entries.content: The Exorcists are a specialised all-female caste of angels, led by Adam the First Man. They are distinguished by their all-black battle uniforms, and horned helmets with expressive black masks displaying white LED eyes and mouths. Every year, Adam leads the Exorcists into the Pride Ring of Hell, where they violently cull the Sinner population to keep it in check. The time between each annual Extermination is counted down on a large clock tower in the middle of Hell's capital, Pentagram City.

entries.name: Adam
entries.content:
Adam is the Biblical first man and the Giver of Names, ascended into one of Heaven's strongest angels, and the Exorcists' leader. He has a tall and stout appearance, wearing a flowing white cloak with a black letter "A" on the chest area. His face is covered by a horned helmet with a black LED mask, displaying gold-colored eyes and sharp-toothed mouth. Underneath the mask, Adam appears human-like, having fair skin, shining golden eyes, short brown hair and a small goatee. He has large golden wings.
Adam is childish, juvenile and foul-mouthed, making casual misogynistic and bigoted jokes and jabs. He is highly egotistical, believing himself, as the father of all humanity and the one who gave names to all living species, to be "perfect" and incapable of doing wrong. However, Adam takes his job very seriously, and has a warm relationship with his female second-in-command, Lute. He personally resents Lucifer for having taken both Lilith and Eve from him. Adam loves rock'n'roll, as well as eating ribs. His signature weapon is a large golden guitar-axe hybrid.

entries.name: Lute
entries.content:
Lute is the second-in-command of the Exorcists, and takes orders directly from Adam himself. She wears the standard Exorcist uniform, but has a black halo with a white outline, and the right eye on her LED mask has an X-shaped pupil. Underneath the mask, she is a striking young woman, with pale skin, short silver hair and golden eyes.
Lute is a ruthless zealot, whose sheer bloodlust and hatred for Sinners sometimes disturbs even Adam himself. Nonetheless, they have a strong friendship, and act very sweet with each other. A few years ago, Lute personally oversaw Vaggie's expulsion from the Exorcists, ripped off her wings and stabbed out Vaggie's left eye – all for refusing to kill a Sinner child.

entries.name: Lilith Morningstar
entries.content:
Lilith is the original first woman, created even before Eve, and is the wife to Lucifer, nominally being the Queen of Hell. She is a tall statuesque demoness with pale lilac skin, long platinum-blonde hair, and light-violet eyes with white irises. She also has a pair of magenta horns, and dark lips. Lilith wears an extravagant purple dress and a golden tiara adorned with red jewels.
Lilith is polite and well-mannered. She used to love Lucifer, but left him due to his depressive attitude and flagrant disregard for his Sinner subjects. Now, Lilith lives as a VIP in Heaven, spending her time lounging on its many beautiful beaches. She still misses her daughter Charlie, but cannot directly communicate with her, due to the terms of the deal Lilith made with Adam to stay in Heaven.
